evals.name: ordered-note
evals.expected_output: A note with breaking changes first, then features, then fixes, each entry citing its version.
assertions: Breaking changes appear before features and fixes

evals.name: skipped-versions
evals.prompt: Summarize the changelog from 1.0.0 to 1.3.0, where the 1.2.0 section is missing.
evals.expected_output: A note that reports the missing 1.2.0 section.

evals.name: empty-range
evals.expected_output: A note saying the range holds no versions.
assertions: Says there is nothing to summarize rather than inventing content
